name: a2a_call
description: Call a remote A2A agent: fetch its AgentCard, send one user message, follow the returned Task until it reaches a terminal state, and return the artifact text. Use for interoperability with external A2A agents, not for local subagents.

card_url.description: URL of the remote AgentCard JSON, for example http://127.0.0.1:8787/a2a/default/agent-card.json.

prompt.description: Text to send to the remote agent as one ROLE_USER message.

skill.description: Optional A2A skill id advertised by the remote card. Omit to let the remote agent choose.

token_env.description: Optional environment variable name holding a Bearer token for the remote endpoint. The token itself is never passed in tool arguments.

timeout_ms.description: Total polling budget in milliseconds; default 60000.

prompt: Outbound A2A call: `a2a_call` fetches a remote AgentCard, sends one text message, and polls the remote task to completion. Requires the remote agent to speak A2A v1.0 JSON-RPC.
